messages:
Samir (Partnerships): Hey team — quick thread to lock down the *IntegrateNow* SI co-sell claim flow before pilot launch tomorrow. Need a short, enforceable rule set we can put in the partner playbook.

Jenna (SI Ops): +1. TL;DR what are we asking SIs to do when they get a lead?

Samir (Partnerships): Intake flow I'm proposing: 1) SI sees lead in SFDC > they tag `rnw_partnership:integratenow` 2) 48h claim window starts 3) if SI claims, they move to owner and set `partner_claimed:true`, else lead returns to CRO queue.

Wei (Sales): 48h seems tight for large accounts. Can we make it tiered? Tier A (>$1M ARR) gets 5 business days, Tier B 48h, Tier C 24h?

Priya (Marketplace): Agree on tiered windows. For marketplace-origin leads we should auto-prioritize (shorter window) because devs demo quickly. Also — for multi-region accounts, SI must indicate region in tag (e.g., `integratenow_eu`).

Jenna (SI Ops): That works. We also need a simple SFDC list view + a query snippet we can share. Proposed saved list filter: `WHERE rnw_partnership = 'integratenow' AND partner_claimed != true ORDER BY created_date DESC`.

Samir (Partnerships): Adding a canonical claim action: create task "SI: claim within window" and add `claim_deadline` field. Minimal friction.

Omar (Legal): Two quick legal guardrails: 1) No SI may claim accounts under active NDA review unless Legal OKs — tag `nda_under_review:true`. 2) Any joint announcement needs approval; do not mark as "co-sell approved" until marketing + legal thumbs up.

Wei (Sales): Noted. For account mapping: what about contested accounts where both internal AE and SI want ownership? Proposed split: if AE opens play within 7 days of lead, AE retains priority unless they explicitly waive. Otherwise SI claim stands.

Priya (Marketplace): Also include: if lead came from marketplace listing, marketplace origin wins tie unless AE has existing pipeline >$X. Helps avoid marketplace churn.

Jenna (SI Ops): Ops checklist for claiming flow (to be scripted into onboarding): 
- Verify tags: `rnw_partnership`, `region`, `origin`
- Confirm no `nda_under_review:true`
- Set `partner_claimed:true` + `claim_deadline`
- Create one-line intake note with recommended next step

Samir (Partnerships): Can someone draft a short public-facing blurb SIs can show customers about the co-sell process? Keep it ~2 lines.

Wei (Sales): I'll draft: "We're partnering with IntegrateNow to accelerate your Redwood integration — our SI will coordinate next steps and may work with Redwood to deliver enterprise support and commercial terms"

Omar (Legal): Make sure that blurb doesn't promise SLAs. Replace "enterprise support" with "deployment support".

Priya (Marketplace): FYI — partnership-bot can auto-tag marketplace-origin leads with `origin:marketplace`. @partnerships-bot — can you confirm the automation is live?

partnerships-bot: Automation check: marketplace tagging is live since 2025-11-10. Current backlog with `rnw_partnership:integratenow` = 12 leads.

Samir (Partnerships): Great. Final ask: can SI Ops produce a 1-pager with the claim rules + SFDC snippet and drop in the IntegrateNow partner Confluence page by EOD? Jenna?

Jenna (SI Ops): Yep — will post a one-pager and include the saved list + a screenshot of the tag UI.

Samir (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. After Jenna posts, I'll send the partner-facing blurb to IntegrateNow and lock the pilot config. :rocket:

Wei (Sales): One small follow-up: add an escalation path — if SI hasn't responded within 24h of claim, email the SI lead and cc AE. I'll add contacts to the doc.

Jenna (SI Ops): Will add escalation steps and an `escalation_email` field to the SFDC task template.

Samir (Partnerships): Perfect. Closing thread once doc is live. If anyone has last-minute objections, post here.

Priya (Marketplace): No objections. Thanks — excited to get this rolling. :tada:
